result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a broken/missing image placeholder is shown for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, plus minor notes. Otherwise the layout renders correctly.

issues.description: The featured card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken image placeholder (grey icon inside an empty grey box) instead of an actual photo, despite this being the top 'Popular right now' item with a €0 delivery badge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure a real image is loaded for the restaurant; if unavailable, show a branded placeholder image or category illustration instead of the raw broken-image icon.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button floats on a plain grey background with no image, which looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Consider rendering an image or neutral background so a missing photo doesn't leave a plain grey block.
